tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (53)re ba med pa'i lu bstan bzhugs/'jig rten rgan po la phyag 'tshal lo/yul rma yul gyi dge bshes bsod nams dpal ldan zhal nas khong la lugs gnyis kyi
(53)re ba med pa'i lu bstan bzhugs/'jig rten rgan po la phyag 'tshal lo/yul rma yul gyi dge bshes bsod nams dpal ldan zhal nas khong la lugs gnyis kyi

tei:div.tei:p: (53)re ba med pa'i lu bstan bzhugs/ 'jig rten rgan po la phyag 'tshal lo/ yul rma yul gyi dge bshes bsod nams dpal ldan zhal nas khong la lugs gnyis kyi blang dor la lung bstan gnang dgos zhes lan grags mang por gsungs 'dug nga la lung bstan med ces zhus kyang mi gsan pas/ cis kyang khyod rang gi sems la dran pa zhig shod dang lo gsungs pas/ 'o na gang dran dran yin na lung bstan yin pas khyab pa khas blangs la/ bden gtam zhig byed na dang po chos lugs la shes gal che yang*/ nga ni brgyud pa bzang po zhig gi rigs 'od gsal snying thig pa yin kyang*/ pha rgan ni shi snga/ bud snga*/ a ma rjogs chen rgan mo zhig yod pa des dang la mgo bca' ma zhog gces lang ma btang bas/ bu nga rang ni rkang ngan/ dran rgyu mang po/ kha so mthon po/ mi byed dgu byed zhig yod pas/ nyin gcig bsam pa la/ ngas rig 'jin (54)gyi gdung 'tshob/ pha myes dgongs ma'i brgyud pa zin pa zhig dgos pas da chos cig sgrub bsam nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam sne nas yar gom pa nyal nyol re gnyis blang nas 'gro ba'i dus na yid la med pa zhig la 'jag rten chos brgyad kyi rgan po kho byung nas/ a le ma 'gro dang zer nas nga cung bshol 'dug ngas kyang kho la bshad res gcig byas pas nga rang rgyal rgyal 'dra mo zhig re dus/ khos nga rang la chir gyis bzung nas kha mar dkyu ngas yar dkyus/ phar 'then tshur 'then 'ga' byas pa na nga rang ni gcig pur song*/ chos brgyad kho dpung dang stobs shugs btsan pas nga'i kha 'ar gyis bskor nas 'khor ba na mar sems yengs phyal gyis btang nas dam pa'i chos phyogs nas ni lung bstan mi 'ong thag gis chod/ gnyis pa 'jig rten gyi lugs la ni thog nes nas gom shugs che bas gom pa gal chen de yang yod mthong rgya shes rgya yang che/ ngan tshes sdug goms la song bas gtso (55)bo gros dpon zhig byed nas 'jig rten lugs kyi gral mgo zhig nas bsdad kyang 'os pa zhig yod pas de lugs kyi rang gi gang bsam zhig zhus nas/

da lo gsar tshes 'dir khyed rang la rtsub cha shin tu che bas/ de la rim gro sngar smros pa de 'grub nges dang*/ khyed rang gi yi dam la bsnyen pa rtags thon zhig byung na gzhan rkyen gyi bar chad de bzlog nges lags/ rang rkyen gyi bar chad drag bsnyen gyi e bzlog mi shes pas rtag tu dma' mo'i sa bzung*/ hrul po'i gos gyon/ bzang ngan 'bring gsum thams cad gong du khur/ rigs gzugs stobs kyi pho tshug de shig la/ nga zer rgyu'i 'gong nag 'di la ci thub re byed dgos snyam/ de nas bya lo'i bar du rkyen gegs cung zad re yod kyang cher mad snyams/ khyad par khyed rang rtsog grib lhang mo zhig red pas lo shas su/ zas rtsog dang*/ gos nag mi nag gi khyim bgrod la shin tu 'jem dgos/ ma 'jem (56)na de red zer ba zhig 'ong du yod/ de'i rim gro zas gos gnas grog kyis grib la 'jem zhing sme ba brtsegs pa dang*/ rnam 'joms rgyun du chags med dgos/ de ma yin par rtag tu dkor za grong 'khyams la mi tshe phud na yon bdag gi byur dang rkyen chags thams cad bla ma la g.yang chags nas phu ya ki na rnga brdung*/ mda' ma ki na yas khyer/ mi byed dgu byed skya ser gnyis go chod pa'i ban ma hor zhig la 'gro nyan yod pas gzab dgos yang khyer rang bzang po/ pha rgod po/ bu khreb rgan zhig gi brgyud pa red pas/ blo rgya ni che/ shes pa ni rgod/ dpung shes ni che/ kha ni mkhas grogs ni bzang*/ da ni gshin rje'i rgyal po la yang nga ci 'jigs snyam pa'i snyems byed kyi bdud rgan dpe khyed rang la gna' nas bdag po zhig byed gin 'dug pas/ de'i rim gro la/ a bu'i zhal nas/ sems la dran tshad kha yi smra rgyu min/ kha yi smras tshad lag tu blang rgyu min gsungs (57)pa 'di thugs la nam yang zhog khyed rang mkhas pa yin/ mi rang kun gyi zer yang*/ mkhas pa mkhas pa zer ba de 'chi mkhas pa zhig la zer ba yin na ma gtogs/

'jig rten gyi mi chen bla dpon gros 'dun mkhan la mkhas pa mi zer/ de tshe gtan gyi gros 'dun mi shes pa'i blun po red/ des na khyed rang kyi 'jig rten gyi gros 'dun gyi phug 'dug blo phud/ kha byung lag snon ci byed kyang*/ ston pa thugs rje can rjes 'jug zhig yin nas bzung rgyud chud 'ja' ba la 'di las thu ba med/ khyad par khyed rang gis da sngon lo shes la thos bsam byas pa thams cad don med la gtong tshad red pas/ de la rim gro shes shes khong du sba/ dran tshad khar mi 'don/ chung sems las med par sdod/ de 'dra ma byung na bsod nams dang rlung rta po dar dus bya ba thams cad las mam 'gro ba 'dra mo yod rung*/ las mar 'gro zhig dang thug dus ci byas kyang rang gzhan (58)phung la sbyor ba las med pas/ kha 'go shad 'go khur/ sde krugs pa rdzas kyi bla ma mthong chos su gyur pa rnams la ltos la rang rgyud la rtogs dpyod rgyob/ des na 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag dgra 'dul gnyen skyongs te khyim pa rgan po zhig gi bya ba red/ rang re ston pa'i rjes 'jug yin rtsis kyi dgra gnyan rengs la gteng*/ zhing tha regs la gtong ba 'di dran dgos/ yang mi tshe chos bshad la btang na bla ma mtshan ldan slob ma snod ldan dkon/ gnyis ka 'jom pa shin tu dkon/ slob ma rnams nas dang po chos chos zer nas dad pa dang don gnyer che mdog byed/ lo shas song dus kho la mi nyan pa zhig byung nas chos las phyir log cing tshe 'di snang zhig la kha ldan gyis 'gro bas/ bla mas a kho de zhes bos kyang*/ khos phyi mig gcig kyang mi lta ba'i slob ma yang yod pas/ bshad pas mi tshe phud nas dgos pa chung*/ nyams chung don gnyer mkhan re gnyis la ci dgos ga ler ltos/ mi tshe sgrub pas 'da' ba (59)deng dkon mo red/ dang po tshe 'di blos mi thong bar du rang gzhan gyi mthun rkyen 'jom dka'/ tha ma chos dang mthun pa 'ong gi mi 'dug

bskyed rim zer dus lha nag hring hring yan lag ma tshang pa zhig bsgom/ sngags mgo med 'jug med pa re bzla bsam pa la nga'i dgra bgegs gang yin pa de khug la shog pod la shog bsam pas go mi chod/ rdzogs rim la'ang rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad mi shes shes kyang gal chung la lus/ la las sems 'di sgom red zer/ la las 'di ma red zer/ ci zer cha mi byed pa zhig gis mi tshe stong zad byas pa'i sgrub pa'i gzugs brnyan des mi 'ongs bas/ de la thos bsam sgom gsum dkrugs mar byas pa 'di khegs che bas lam gnad dang mthun pa re mjod/ bshad sgrub re res mi tshe phu rgyu mi 'ong res 'jog can la bsgom pa gtso bor mjod/ bya brag sdom bu sa la re ba byed gin yod tshod 'dra ste/ chos dang mthun (60)pa ni mi 'ong*/ deng song gi bya bral dag sdom bu sa zer ba'i khyi mgo dbyug pas brdung*/ mi mgo g.yo sgyu'i brdung*/ rang mgo rang gis brdung*/ zhing lpags kyi lha dkrog 'dre nyal phaṭa kyis slong*/ rkang dung gis khyi phyogs/ ḍa ru'i mi phyogs kyi lha min 'dre min re 'ong shas che yang dgos pa med/ rang yul gyi rang phyogs gi gnas yid la gang dga' rer lo shas sdod/ dgon gog po re nas lo shas bsdad na skyon cher med/ khong bla ma rnams snyan khung srab/ thugs mi sgom zur mgo rag gang la 'ang nyan po btsug 'dug grwa pa rnams bsam pa ngan/ kha mang*/ bya byed rgod bya khwa ta grags pa 'dra mo yin 'dug pas/ de la yang bde mo med/ des na rang kha rang gis gsos/ rang rgyab rang gi bsro/ rang g.yog rang gis byed/ rang gang la blo 'gro ba'i chos dang*/ gnas la brten na gyong dang mi kha mi 'byung*/ rang byas kyi rang mkhong de mi dgos pa yi pas de tsho thugs la 'chong*/ de yang snyigs ma'i skye bo yin stabs kyi (61)chos re i 'grub bsam dus gnas grogs longs spyod kyis gshol 'debs/ yang 'jig rten 'di gcig bsgrub bsam na gnas grogs longs spyod thams cad bdag la 'bros 'bros byed pas/

chos ma rtogs bsam rgyu dang dran rgyu med pa 'ong na/ ma 'ong na phyir gyed/ ldog pa brag la gtad nas 'bad dgos/ 'bad 'bungs chos la gyis/ 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag mang po che bzhag chung bskyur la ci thon thon du 'bad pa 'di lung bstan mthar thug pa yin pas/ rten 'brel ma 'chug pa mjod e he he/ 'jig rten gyi lugs bstan 'di kaḥthog rgyud sde'i bshad sgrub nor bu'i lhun po nas chos smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis bris pa dge'o/ ༈ mchog gzigs sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i drung du/ phul zhus/ nyid rin po che thugs brtses khyab pa'i gsung glegs nyams med rtsal ba la gus spro thob/ ches zhus/ thog med las nyon dang lhan du bcas (62)ltu dal bshags 'bul byed pa ni/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa la/ phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur pa na/ zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mjes te/ dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ gsung pa lags pas bka' drin gang tsher lags/ sngar rag khyab kyi dgon par cha mthun sgyud gsum bcad pa'i rkyen gyur la nyes pa cher yod pa ma mthong te/ gal te de nyid rnam par bshad pa na/ gzhan gzhung 'jig par gyur na nyes pa med/ gsungs pa'i rjes su 'gro ste gter ston de'i gter phug lho brag mkhar chu sogs nas chos dbyings su rdib pa'i lo rgyus zhib mo spro rgyu yod/ rdor sems kyi sgrub mchod bzhag mjad pa la ni gus spro snying nas 'bul/ da dung yang*/ mkhan chen gyis sman chog sogs 'jug rgyu mjad na/ rang lugs sgros gtsang bkra shis la byin brlabs che ba'i chos min gshis des dga' ba yin mod kyang*/ dus phyis rten bzhag (63)rnams ni mthar tshogs ngan las bzang po 'ong ba dka' mor 'dug pas/ skabs skabs las rgyun du gtan chags mjad pa las min thugs dpyod gnang thub zhu zhu/ nyid dam pa nas rta khung 'bar ba 'di la bsnyen pa zhig la bzhugs nas legs snyams pa byung ba la bsnyen pa la bzhugs dus su mkho ba'i zhal gdams gsungs kyang*/

rang nyams la ma lon pa'i rtog ge'i kha bshad mkhan bdag la de 'dra'i re ba cher ma byung kyang*/ 'on kyang bla ma dang slob ma yin khul gyis rang blor nges pa cung zad gcig mi brjod ka med stabs gshis cung zad zhu na/ spyir chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba blo blog rnam pa bzhi po 'di 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gi skabs gang yin la thugs nyams su bstar dgos pa ni/ sngar kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang*/ ngal bso skor gsum sogs kyi bshad pa phul dus su rang gi gang shes zhus pa las/ gzhan zhu 'os med la/ khyad par bsnyen (64)pa'i skabs su'ang*/ thun mong phyi nang gi rim pa rnams gsang ba spyi'i 'gros gzhan du yod/ drag po rta khung 'bar 'di ni nang sgrub rig 'jin 'dus pa'i cha lag lta bur bsdu na lung a nu yo gar gtog pa 'dra yang*/ ma hā a nu gang yin kyang bla la/ tshig ris la ma hā ltar snang mod/ de'i dbang du na gzhi lta bas gtan la phab/ lam sgom pas nyams su blangs/ 'bras bu gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi rang bzhin brtan pa gsum du 'du bas/ dang po ni he ru ka galpo las/ gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi/ lhag pa'i chos sku bcings grol med/ ces pas gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi dang*/ 'khrul pas btags pa'i gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi sems nyid gdod nas dag pa'i rang bab gshis kyi bzhugs tshul dri mas gos ma myong ba'i rang bzhin ye dag gi sangs rgyas/ rang bzhin rnams dag gi sangs rgyas/ rang rig don gyi bla ma/ chos nyid don gyi lha/ chos nyid kyi mkha' la thugs rje'i rtsal (65)shar grol 'gags med du 'gro ba'i mkha' 'gro ste/ rtsa ba gsum gyi rang bzhin ye nas rang dang 'du 'bral med pa rang chas lhun grub du bzhugs pa'i chos nyid de sgrub gzhi'am sgrub bya yin la/ gnyis pa 'khrul pas brtags pa'i gzhi ni/ de lta bu'i gnas lugs 'od gsal ba'i ye shes de la sgrib pa'i cha/ ma rig 'khrul pas bslad pa'i nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa rnams yin la/

de rnams bsdu na phung po lnga/ de yang bsdus na/ thu mal mtshan 'jin gyi rnam rtog nyag ma gcig po 'di la 'du bas 'di nyid bsal bya'i spangs bya yin la/ de ni nyan thos ltar mi spangs/ byang sems ltar mi bsgyur bar/ 'dir ni 'khrul pa gzhi nas dag pa rdzogs chen/ lam nas dag pa sngags kyi theg pa 'og ma/ 'bras bu nas dag pa rgyu mtshan nyid pa ltar gsum las/ 'khrul pa lam nas dag pa'i sngags thun mong ba ltar re zhig bshad na/ tha mal mtshan rtog gi gnyen (66)po gya noram lhar zhen gyi rtog pas rtog pa 'dul ba yin pas de ltar bya dgos pa ni gzhi dang*/ gnyis pa lam la'ang*/ lta spyod dkyil 'khor dbang dam tshig mchod sngags ting 'jin phrin sgrub po/ rang bzhin bcu las/ dbang ni sngar thob pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de'i srog dam tshig la rags las pas de yang kha zhe mngon lkog med pa'i mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du srung ba gzhir bzhag gi steng nas lta ba sogs lam gyi 'gros gzhan ba ci dgos pa dgongs chub bgyis nas/ skabs 'dir lta ba cung zad gcig bshad na/ sngar bstan pa'i gzhi de shes bya'am gzhal bya'i yul du byas nas/ dang po rgyu gcig pa'i gtan tshig gis chos thams cad ngo bo skye med du gtan la phab/ yig 'bru'i tshul gyis gtan tshig gis rol pa 'gags med du gtan la phab/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtan tshig gis dbyer med zung 'jug du gtan la bab/ mngon sum pa'i gtan tshig gis mtshan nyid blo gral du gtan la phab te/ rang gi sems nyid kyi bab/ gshis (67)yin lugs sam/ chos nyid skye ba med pa rnam thar gsum ldan gyi stong pa nyid ye nas yin pa la yin pa'i nges shes dang*/ de'i rtsal lam rol pa 'char tshul 'gags pa med pa phyi nang snod bcud ltar snang ba sku/ grags pa gsungs/ dran rtogs thugs kyi rol pa snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi dkyil 'khor da lta'i snang ba 'di spu ma brjes/ mdog ma bsgyur ba'i rang bzhin 'di stong nges nas stong nyid mtshan med smon med 'od gsal ba'i ye shes/

snang ngos nas sku dang ye shes kyi rol pa/ snang ba stong thog tu spyan ma drang ba'i rang bzhin dbyer mad zung 'jug chen po/ sangs rgyas sgom pas ma mjad/ sems can sgron pos ma bcos pa'i chos nyid do/ tha mal gyi rtog dpyod kyi yul las 'das pa so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi yul dang yul can gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis mjal ba'i tha snyad btags pa ni/ ji ltar nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa/ nam mkha'i ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtags par (68)gyis/ zhes pa'i don la rig pa spyi blugs su 'jog pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'jin/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la rang bzhin ngang gis snying rje chen po mkha' khyab tu bsgom pa'i kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'jin dang ngo bo stong nyid/ gdangs snying rje chen po/ rnam pa hrīḥyig dmar por gsal ba ni rgyu ting yin pas 'di dag ni bskyed rim ci snyed pa'i srog gi srog dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer zer ba de yin pas/ rgyu mtshan des na 'og gzhi nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas dkyil dbus kyi gtso bo gnyis la la thugs mkhyen brtse/ gsung tshangs dbyangs/ sku mtshan dpe'i yon tan la khyad par med pa dang*/ rnam pa la gtso 'khor gzhal yas sogs su snang ba tsam las med par thams cad chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i rol pa chu'i rlabs nyi ma'i zer bzhin dbyer med par shes pa 'di gnas gal chen lags snyam bgyis/ de nas bskyed pa lha'i gzer ni/ de lta bu'i stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa las 'di ltar nam mkhas gar khyab pad+ma 'od drag po (69)rol pa'i zhing khams gzhal yas khang tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i dbus su/ rang gis sems nyid kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed khro bo lod mngon rtogs gzhung dang mthun pa snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gsal la de 'jin bral ba chu zla dang gzugs brnyan bzhin ma 'dres 'ja' tshon ltar gsal ba'o/

gsum pa bzlas pa sngags gzer ni/ rang nyid drag po'i thugs ka'i nyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthar sngags rnams g.yas bskor du gnas pa/ de la zla ba skar phreng dang*/ rgyal po'i pho nya dang*/ bung ba tshang zhig dang*/ 'gal me ltar bzhi las 'di ni phyi ma ltar sngags phreng gcig las byung*/ rim bzhin 'gal me ltar gyur nas shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ gsang ba nas tshur brgyud rtsa ba'i sngags phreng la rim par dmigs pa bying ba'i gnyen po dang*/ sngags phreng gsang ba nas shangs bug g.yon nas tshur byung rtsa ba'i sngags phreng la thim pa ni sems dgod pa'i gnyen po yin/ gang ltar yang de las 'od zer me (70)stag gi tshwa tshwa thol thol 'phro ba phyogs bcu 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams mchod/ snod bcud ma dag pa'i dngos po thams cad sbyangs nas lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pa nyag cig tu blta bas 'jab bzla/ bzhi pa 'phro 'du phrin las kyi gzer ni/ de ltar sngags phreng las 'od zer me stag gi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ drag po'i gsung gi rta skad 'tsher bas snang srid thams cad shig shig yom yom du 'gul ba thugs khyung gi tshwa tshwa yang phyogs phyogs su 'phro bas ma dag mtshan rtog gi snang ba thams cad chos nyid du zhi ba dang*/ rang snang ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas pa dang*/ tha mal mtshan rtog gi chos thams cad dbang du 'du ba dang*/ gnyis 'jin rtog pa'i bdud bgegs mnyamapa chen po'i tshar bcad pa drag po'i phrin las thams cad chos nyid gcig la brtse ba'am gsang ba spyi ltar zhi rgyas dbang drag mchog gi phrin las dang lnga po lhun grub tu sgrub pa'o/ rgyu dngos gzhan rnams dgongs su gsol/ gsum pa 'bras bu ni/ dang po tha mal (71)mtshan rtog gi gnyen po bskyed rim lha'i ting nge 'jin sogs bsgoms pas/ rab dngos 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam rnams su lha'i sku mthong*/ gsung thob/ byin gyis rlabs pa la sogs pa'i rtogs mthong nas thun mong kyi dngos grub grub pa brgyad la sogs pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*/

de nas sems lha skur smamin kyang lus ma smin pa rnam smin rig 'jin dang*/ mthong lam ye shes kyi mos tha mal gyi lus dwangs mar sbyangs nas lam mchog yongs rdzogs tshe dbang*/ min na mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor nus zhing lus sbyang ma nus pas phyag chen rig 'jin te bar dor dag pa'i sgyu lus slob pa'i zung 'jug du lhang nus nas mthar pa thams cad bgrod pa dang*/ mi slob zung 'jug gi go 'phang sku lnga lhun grub rdo rje 'chang gi sa brnyes pa pa lhun grub rig 'jin ste bzhis lam lnga ka bsdu bar 'dod pa'am/ zur pa'i dgos pa ltar rig 'jin rnam pa bzhi'i 'phags pa slob lam kho na bsdus par 'dad pa'i lugs gnyis gang ltar yang (72)sems nyid 'od gsal ba'i ye shes de'i sgrib pa thams cad lam goms pa'i stobs kyis bsal nas/ ye ji bzhin pa'i gshis mngon du gyur pa la 'bras bu sku lnga gsung lnga/ thugs lnga/ yon tan lnga/ phrin lnga lhun grub tu gyur pa la 'bras bu zhes brjod pa yin te/ dpal mda' bsnun zhabs kyis/ sa dang lam dang sangs rgyas thams cad go gcig pas/ gnyug ma'i ye shes de nyid yin gyis de la dris/ zhes gsungs so/ mdor na dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang gi rgyud la rtog dpyod zhib mo rgyob/ don med pa'i bya ba gang 'jug 'di don med pas/ dran shes bag yod rgyud la brten/ lar su la'ang blo ma gtod/ rang thag rang gis bcad dgos med rgyud la brten/ 'chi ba snying nas bcang*/ bsam rgyu chos las med pa/ bsgom rgyu chos las mad pa/ rgyu 'bras la zhib che/ lta ba la yangs che ba spyod pa la zhib che ba/ blo rtse dkon mchog la gtod pa 'di ma gtog med pa dgos/ blo sna mang ba/ bya byed rgad pa/ 'gro 'dug mang ba/ 'brel 'dris che ba (73)kun dang mthun pa de snyigs dus chos pa'i bdud lags so/ don med pa'i 'chal gtam du thal ha ha/ gsol 'debs ni/ rdo rje dbyings kyi gtso mchog kun tu bzang*/

mkha' mnyam klong dgu'i ye shes gzi brjid rtsal/ tshom bu dgu yi ngo bor yongs shar ba/ dpal chen grub pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ ces kyang smras so/ slar yang gsang ba zab mo'i dga' ston chad med du gsol ba'i rten 'byung du myong grol rten bcas med med bya byed mang ba'i brel ngang nas phul zhu/ bla ma rin po che mi pham zla ba bzhi pa'i nyer dgu la zhing gzhan du byon song lags/ rgyun khyer mang rigs kyi thun mjug la skye 'chi gnyis ka sbyong ba'i bsdu lhang gnyis ka dgos nges yin/ rgyun spyod la rang gi yi dam gtso bo'i lam khyer yin kyang*/ skabs bab rta khyung skabs thun mtshams kyi lha rta khyung nyid yin lags/ dbu rgyan la khro bo'i skabs rin po che'i rtsa chings la thod pa skam po rin po che'i rtse phran can nang rigs lnga'i (74)he ru ka'i dbu rgyan bzhengs lha lta bu yin/ zhi ba la dbu skra zur phud lnga pa'i skra mtshams na maṇ+ḍal gyi lcags ri lta bu'i rin po che'i phra mtshams kyis spras pa zur phud dbus dang phyogs lnga pa rtse ma maṇ+ḍal gyi tog lta bu'i rin po che'i sgrom khang stong lnga'i nang du rigs lnga sprul sku'i cha byad can bzhugs pa lags/ rta khyung gi gnas gsum gyi lha rnams tshig zin ltar thod khrag yin snyams/ yi ge brgya pa la 'dra min snang kyang*/ kun mkhyen chen po'i bla ma yang tig nang ltar yin snyams/ ༈ yang mang 'thus pa sgom zer ba rnams la sngon 'gro rgyas pa re shod/ 'bum lnga dang sid+dhi bye ba gsum tsam re song dus dngos gzhi'i khrid gsung rgyu rig 'jin gong ma'i phyag bzhes lags pas/ de ltar sngon 'gro'i sbyang ba cha tshang ba re song dus/ dngos gzhi rgyas bsdus gdul bya'i blo dang bstun la rim gyis khrid na legs lam che/ rang bzhin 'bum lnga tsam ma song na kho la go rgyu yang ci yang mi 'dug bskal pa grangs med gcig gis bsags sbyang gi dod po red pas (75)sngon 'gro'i sbyang pa rnams rgyas dgos zhes bla ma rin po che'i zhal lung yin/

gsang sngags yi ge'i gzungs kyi rnam par shar/ lha nyid yi ge yi ge lha nyid las/ logs su sgrub rdul tsam ma dmigs pas/ rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i snang brnyan gshin rje'i gshed/ thugs srog 'pho med dwangs ma'i ngo bo nyid/ ye nas gnas pa'i 'khor lo thugs la gnas/ gcod pa'i 'khor lo rten 'brel gnas su dag sprul pa'i 'khor lo skyed byed ma 'gags pa/ srid pa'i 'khor lo sbyang bya 'khrul pa'i chos/ 'jam dpal dgongs pa 'di rtsam 'dus po zhes/ gshin rje grub pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje gsungs/ bu khyod tshe 'di'i snang shes rgyab tu bor/ 'khrul snang log rtog sgyu ma'i snang ba 'dis/ ye nas rang byung snying po byang chub sems/ ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid du sbyor/ bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i brtson pas ma 'dor dang*/ mchog thun grub la som nyi'i skabs dang bral/ tshe rab kun tu rgyal kun yab gcig khyed/ rjes su bzung (76)shing blang dor dmigs byed nas/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad g.yul las rgyal/ kho yi lha gcig 'jam dpal gzhon nu yis/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzigs pa mi dman pas/ khyed la rtag tu dge legs sbyin gyur cig maṅga lam/ ༈ go 'jo bla ma bde chen mgo chen po can de la spring ba/ phran pha yul du nam 'gro khrig chod rin po che ma pheb par zhu ngo ma thog bka' 'gyur gyi lung pha yul du song ma thag yod rgyu thag chod yin/ khyod dran rgyu mang po'i blo sna de/ tshe mi rtag 'chi bas yang yang klog sgom mthon po'i go sa rnyogs pa de/ rang mgo rang gis bskor las che/ chos 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po de/ sngon 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul las/ dus deng song snyigs ma'i sems can la/ mkha'i gza' skar khyi la bstan pa bzhin/ des na blo sna nang du khug blo ldog pa chos bzhi'i nyasam len la/ dus nyin mtshan med par brtson 'grus kyis/ dpyad sgom dang 'jog pa'i bsam gtan la/

blo yang yang sbyang na 'di (77)snang gi blo sna'i grab shom de bzlag de mchi/ las rgyu 'bras phra mo'i mim bslu ba'i/ gnas 'di la yid ches ma skyes na/ ming chos par btags la dgos pa chung*/ chos zhu ba'i don po tshe 'di la/ zhe log ge sgrub 'dod log pa dgos/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam/ ltog pa zas la gdung ba bzhin/ snying nas don gnyer gyi 'dun pa bskyed/ lus cha lugs bsgyur nas ming spos pas/ blo khyim pa rnams dang 'gal ba dgos/ de min par ming la ban+dhe btags/ tshe 'di nyid sgrub pa'i blo sna mang*/ don bya byed mang po'i zang zing gis/ snyigs ma'idus chos pa 'ga' yang bslu/ rang rgyud la med pa'i kha lta mtho/ las 'bras 'jem bag nyin skar gyis/ dben pa'i chos pa song dgos nas/ rgyud chos dang mthun nam rtog dpyod rgyob/ lam yon tan gyi rtsa ba tshul khrims yin/ bya ba la ngo lkog med pa yi/ rgyal ba mnyes pa'i tshul khrims de/ srog dmar po dang bsdos la mig bzhin srung*/ rten de la brten pa'i yon tan gyi chos/ 'jig rten dang 'jig (78)rten las 'das pa'i/ lus shin sbyang 'dres pa'i ting nge 'jin/ 'bad pa dang rtso med du lhun grub 'byung*/ tshul khrims dang ting nge 'jin bzang po las/ chos bdag med rtog pa'i shes rab 'byung*/ 'di rnams ni gcig la gcig brten pa'i/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel yod pas na/ sems 'di la mjub mo btsug nas su/ rang rgyud la nam yang bskyar sbyang dgos/ de ma yin par rang 'dod rtog pa kho'i/ gang 'dod du yan par shor ba na/ khong mi byed bsam pa gcig kyang med/ rang 'dod kyi rtog pa cir yang brdzu/ 'khor ba 'di'i 'jigs dang sdug bsngal kun/ 'di nyid la ma brten mi 'byung bas/ rang 'dod 'gong po la dgra bzhin ltos/ chos brgyad kyi bsam pa dug ltar 'jem/ dad pa dang nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems/ 'di thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam/
gnad thams cad bsdus pa'i gdams pa yin/ don 'thad dam dgongs na nyams su long*/ mi 'thad snyams na gang dgar rol/ ces rtsed mo'i yig chung phul ba dge'o//
